title: Mizzen data lock
description: `mizzen.lock.json`: the address, version, byte size, and SHA-256 of every remote or package collection source.

sources.description: Pinned sources keyed by the address the site config writes.

snapshots.description: Where each collection's data was recorded from, keyed by collection name.

snapshot.description: Where a collection was recorded from. Nothing in it is read from the build clock.

source.description: The source the data was recorded from: a path, a URL, or an `npm:` address.

ref.description: The commit, or the package and exact version, the data was recorded at.

capturedAt.description: When the data was recorded: a date, or a UTC instant to the second, taken from the data and never from the build clock.

tool.description: The tool that recorded it, such as `git` or `npm`.

schema.description: The collection's schema when the data was recorded, for comparing a later schema with it.

version.description: SHA-256 of the schema file's bytes.

file.description: The schema file, relative to the site root.

fields.description: Each top-level field the schema declares, keyed by name.

field.description: One top-level field of a recorded schema.

required.description: True when the schema lists the field as required.

source.description: One pinned source, with the bytes a build may read.

address.description: The source address as the config writes it.

version.description: The installed package version, for an `npm:` source.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source's bytes, as 64 lowercase hex characters.

fetchedAt.description: When a URL source was fetched, from the response's date header and never the build clock.
